_doc: Actuation profiles. The printable kit is static; 'r3x_animation' is the mechanics of the motorised build in Drive MOB/Projects/DJ-R3X/R-3X Animation (parts list '07 - r3x hardware.txt', sample show '08 - r3x maestro sample script.txt'): 8 servos, channel numbers as that script uses them, plus head_roll on channel 17 from Hunter's head mech. That build used a Pololu Maestro; ours will be a custom controller, so the controller here is 'custom' - the sim's pipeline (calibration, soft limits, jerk-limited follower, pulse output) is the reference for its firmware (sim/docs/motion-control.md section 8). 'extended' keeps those 9 and adds arm/claw servos on the Maestro's spare channels. Ring gear ratios are measured from the ring-animation STLs (inner-gear sector pitch radius / servo gear). Anything marked calibration 'assumed' (centreUs, invert, neck and lift gearing) must be set on the bench: jog each servo to the rest pose (every joint 0: show/SPEC.md 'Frame and zeros', not the kit's display pose) and record the pulse. Motion limits are ~70% of loaded capability (sim/docs/motion-control.md). Joints without a channel are posable only.

r3x_animation.label: R-3X Animation mechanics + Hunter head roll (9 servos, custom controller)

channels.name: neck
channels.note: Script centre 5961 qus = 1490 us. Neck-gear ratio not yet measured (1.5 assumed).

channels.name: headlift
channels.note: Rack and pinion, ~12 mm pinion assumed: 0.21 mm per servo degree; 1500 us = rest (0 mm), 800-2200 us = +/-20 mm.

channels.name: headroll
channels.note: Hunter's head mech (mech/assemblies/hunter_head): a push-rod pair, each servo carrying tilt and roll (~2.4 servo deg per roll deg). Independent roll channel until the pipeline mixes; channel 17 is the controller's spare PIO output.

channels.name: visor
channels.note: Push-rod linkage treated as 1:1. Script flaps 4956 <-> 5297 qus (~11 deg).

channels.name: elbow
channels.note: 20 kg double-shaft servo in the hero-arm elbow disc. Script 'up' 7361 qus = rest.

channels.name: lowarm
channels.note: Lower ring: 22T-class servo gear into a ~98 deg internal sector (~3.8:1), carries the poker arm. Script centre 6016 qus ('middle', between 'front' 3200 and 'back' 8832) = rest.

channels.name: heroarm
channels.note: Top ring: servo gear into a ~61 deg internal sector (~4.4:1), carries the hero arm. Script centre 6043 qus ('center', between 'front' 3200 and 'back' 8832) = rest.

extended.label: Extended (18 servos: + arms, claws, middle ring; custom controller)

channels.name: hero_claw
channels.note: One servo opens all three fingers.

channels.name: middle_ring
channels.note: Same gear sector design as the lower ring.
